question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT w1.name AS winner_name, w2.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m 
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id::TEXT 
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id::TEXT
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id::TEXT
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%' 
  AND m.title_change = 0 
  AND m.duration != ''
  AND TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.duration, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.duration, ':', 2) AS INTEGER) = 
    (SELECT MIN(TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m2.duration, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m2.duration, ':', 2) AS INTEGER))
     FROM Matches m2 
     JOIN Belts b2 ON m2.title_id = b2.id::TEXT 
     WHERE b2.name LIKE '%NXT%' 
       AND m2.title_change = 0 
       AND m2.duration != '')
GROUP BY w1.name, w2.name
LIMIT 10
